Impacted Systems: Windows 10 versions before Redstone 1 (April 2016) without MS17-010 patch
Method of Attack: Exploitation of SMB vulnerability to deliver malformed packets and gain initial foothold
Backdoor implant used as second part of exploitation chain to take control and execute malicious code
Attack Vector: Delivery of malformed SMB packets to unpatched SMB service
Use of DOUBLEPULSAR backdoor implant (removed in Windows 10 port by RiskSense)
Indicators of Compromise: Attempts to use ETERNALBLUE exploit itself (network packets with specific malformed fragments)
